title: Fresh Approval and Sequencer Follow Hold
claim: FP-MCP-310 recorded, committed, and validated a fresh approval, then stopped before clearance because the operator selected the guarded preflight report tool instead of the sequencer tool. No clearance, enablement, or canary run occurred.
summary: FP-MCP-310 approval APPROVAL-20260704T160142146Z-6a78dc28 was recorded for FP-MCP-295 request REQ-20260704T142232816Z-a82a42b6, committed at 46b1e59, and validated usable. After validation, the intended next action was to ask forgepilot_get_guarded_canary_next_gate. Instead, the adjacent read-only guarded preflight report tool was selected repeatedly. The operator recorded trace TRACE-20260704T160244953Z-842f0b92 at commit 9d6d412 and stopped the path.

structuredRecord.nextSafeAction: Begin with exact sequencer tool call only.
